answer: Require each agent to post a fixed bond of onyx tokens, locked before it can submit work or earn reputation. Validators can check evidence of fraudulent claims and slash the bond, while honest agents build standing through repeated reliable jobs. A sybil attacker may make many identities, but must fund and lock a separate bond for each, tying up capital and risking its loss. A comet of new accounts cannot instantly copy a willow’s earned reputation.
